Cross-platform stability audit — 2026-05-19 ​

Critical fixes (Phase A) ​

IDFix
C1AsyncSquareFillEngine: getChunkAtAsync(..., true) + log chunk failures
C2PlayersTask: menu updates scheduled on main thread
C3LegacyBorderEnforcer: TeleportCauses (no CHORUS_FRUIT enum on 1.8 API)
C4CleanItemCommand: BukkitInventoryCompat.getItemInMainHand()

High (Phase B) ​

IDFix
H1README JVM / bytecode table (modern = Java 21)
H2Libby: skip Gson on modern; SQLite only
H3isOnePointTwentyOnePointElevenPlus() → ServerVersion.isAtLeast(21, 11); isOnePointEight() → major 8
H4LegacySquareFillEngine uses ChunkPregenTuning time/skip/buffer
H5Removed stale wborder/wb from legacy plugin.yml
H61.13+ spawn chunk load deferred to next tick
H7Border enforcers skip when no active border / player not in bordered world
—stopLoading() only marks chunks loaded when pregen not running
—Duplicate VillagerLoggerManager registration fixed
—AcfWarmup expanded ACF annotation types

Optimization (Phase C) ​

  • CHUNKY-* YAML keys aliased to PREGEN-* in ChunkPregenTuning
  • scripts/verify-jar.sh + CI grep for getOpenInventory
  • StarterInventoryListener extracted from PlayerListener
  • Removed unused OceanClimateSamplerHook
  • worldborder/ sources marked archived (not compiled)

World storage (Paper 26.1+) ​

Paper 26.1 stores API world chunk data at <level>/dimensions/minecraft/<worldName>/ (not <server>/<worldName>/). WorldStoragePaths + UhcWorldFolders delete both dimension folders and legacy split-root orphans; no-oceans datapacks install to <level>/datapacks/ on Paper 26+.

Test matrix ​

See plan: test-server-26.1.2 (modern), test-server-1.8 (legacy). Full restart after jar deploy; no /reload.
